## This project does not accept pull requests

Not standoffishness, and not a comment on your patch. This one is closed on
sight, and it is better that you know now than after a review.

Patternated is AGPL-3.0 and is also used inside Captivated Ltd's own closed
products. That works only because Captivated owns the copyright outright: a
copyright holder is not a licensee of its own work. A merged contribution would
put part of the copyright in somebody else's hands, and the arrangement would
quietly stop holding. There is no version of merging this that does not cost
more than the patch is worth.

[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) has the longer version, and
[`docs/licensing.md`](../docs/licensing.md) has the reasoning in full.

## What is genuinely wanted instead

- **A file that broke it.** The weakest part of this project is that very
  little artwork has been through ingest that it did not draw itself. An SVG
  that fails, or a scan that mattes badly, is worth more than a patch.
- **What it got wrong on fabric.** Almost nobody can supply this.
- **A feature and why**, especially when the reason is a constraint a printer
  imposed on you.

All three are issues, and issues are read.

If you would rather carry the change yourself, fork it: that is what the AGPL
is for. Note that the name is not licensed with the code, so the fork needs its
own.
